description: One case per rejection code the TMS produces. The booking is rejected with UnknownShipper. Known answer: The Shipper is not known to Norvia, so Norvia cannot take the booking. The Shipper should contact Norvia to be set up, or use the account Norvia knows.

setup.seed: Send a booking from a Shipper Norvia does not know (a Persona with no Shipper record). Open the Rejected booking in the TMS UI and set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to its ID.

input: Explain why the Rejected booking ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT} was rejected, and what the Shipper should change.

explanation.rubric: Names the reason (UnknownShipper) in plain language, without the code's name, and says what the Shipper should change: The Shipper is not known to Norvia, so Norvia cannot take the booking. The Shipper should contact Norvia to be set up, or use the account Norvia knows. Does not name who the goods are for.
